claims.claim_text: The University of Toronto is Embree's latest named civilian employer found before his wartime COI/OSS work. He took a position there in 1941, but the available accounts do not establish the precise transition date or rule out an intervening role.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Eggan's 1951 memorial places a Toronto appointment in 1941 and describes subsequent OSS work. Yale repeats that chronology; Densho places a brief COI/OSS stint before the War Relocation Authority.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High: exact indexed name aligns with Eggan's full-name memorial, Yale's profile, and Densho's account of wartime OSS work. The Box 219 file has not been examined.
claims.temporal_assessment: Probable immediate predecessor, not strongly date-bounded: the sources do not give a Toronto separation date or exact COI/OSS entry date.
claims.match_notes: Corrects the earlier high-confidence immediate label while preserving the well-supported fact of Toronto employment. University of Hawaii remains an earlier employer; WRA came after his initial COI/OSS work.
